title: APPLESEED Example Dataset
description: A longitudinal pediatric EEG dataset comprising 48 recording sessions from 13 infants assessed at 4, 8, and 12 months of age, with test-retest reliability measurements. This dataset was used to develop and validate APPLESEED (Automated Preprocessing Pipe-Line for the Estimation of Scale-wise Entropy from EEG Data), a preprocessing pipeline designed for pediatric neuroimaging applications.
methods_description: Longitudinal EEG recordings were collected from infants at multiple timepoints: sessions 1 and 2 at 4 months of age (within 1 week for test-retest reliability assessment), session 3 at 8 months of age, and session 4 at 12 months of age. Complete longitudinal data (sessions 1-4) were obtained from 11 infants (6 female), while 2 additional infants contributed reliability data only (sessions 1-2). Channel location files and bin files for analysis are provided.
